usage: arb-engine inplay [-h] [--position POSITION] [--steal-edge STEAL_EDGE]
                         [--target-margin TARGET_MARGIN] [--contracts CONTRACTS] [--gold]
                         [--interval INTERVAL] [--duration DURATION] [--iterations ITERATIONS]
                         [--once] [--journal JOURNAL] [--no-espn] [--record [DB]]
                         [--bankroll BANKROLL] [--kelly KELLY]
                         url

positional arguments:
  url                   Robinhood game event URL

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --position POSITION   lot you hold, venue:outcome:price:count[:exchange], e.g.
                        robinhood:DEN:0.50:100 (repeatable)
  --steal-edge STEAL_EDGE
                        all-in must be this far below consensus fair to flag STEAL
  --target-margin TARGET_MARGIN
                        extra locked margin required per $1 for LOCK
  --contracts CONTRACTS
  --gold
  --interval INTERVAL
  --duration DURATION
  --iterations ITERATIONS
  --once                evaluate once and print
  --journal JOURNAL
  --no-espn             do not pull live game state / model (market consensus only)
  --record [DB]         append every tick (game state, sources, actions) to this SQLite file (bare
                        flag: out/history.db)
  --bankroll BANKROLL   dollars you are willing to deploy; STEAL alerts then say how many
                        contracts (fractional Kelly, capped by depth)
  --kelly KELLY         Kelly fraction for sizing (default 0.25)
